h1: Custom Rainbow Lanyards & Badges for Events
metaTitle: Custom Rainbow Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom rainbow lanyards & badges for your next event. Bright, durable, and perfect for Pride or themed promotions.
introHtml: Rainbow lanyards offer a vibrant way to show support for diversity and inclusion at corporate events, Pride celebrations, or community gatherings. Unlike standard solid-color lanyards, the rainbow pattern makes a bold statement that aligns with your organization's values. These custom rainbow lanyards and badges are ideal for HR directors planning company-wide inclusion initiatives or marketing directors seeking eye-catching giveaways. Durable polyester construction ensures they hold up during multi-day events, and full-color imprinting lets you add your logo prominently.
heroAltText: Custom rainbow lanyards and badges with colorful stripes and printed logo for events
